audit_result: Independent audit PASSED. Single-process matched-prefix fork removes the historical-prefix confound; snapshot/restore of model+optimizer+RNG+training index is exact in-process (validated by preflight); arms differ only by English LR schedule after global update 100; all SF2 data/objective/KL/scope/binding/optimizer/evaluation/gate/transfer semantics preserved (verified against frozen SF2/SF3/SF4 code); seeds/endpoints/decision rule were frozen prospectively; eval RNG-invariance is enforced; matched-step-101 equality gate and per-arm output isolation added as mechanical integrity checks.
hypothesis: Linearly annealing only the late English learning rate (global updates 101-200, English ordinal j=1..90: lr=5e-5*(90-j)/89, binding LR constant 5e-5) prevents the constant-LR Owen-side boundary sweep that left SF2 at 15/16 (one Alex-correct near-tie missed), while preserving SF2 retention.
seed_policy: fixed prospectively; one fresh process per seed; no outcome-based selection

per_seed_design.prefix: global updates 1-100 with byte-identical SF2 semantics (frozen SF2_ENGINE code path: data/schedule/KL pool/objective/scope/optimizer/dropout modes unchanged)
per_seed_design.snapshot_at_100: capture full in-process state after update 100 (model, optimizer, Python/CPU/GPU RNG, english_index=90, completed=100, scope) BEFORE any RNG-consuming evaluation; capture consumes no training RNG
per_seed_design.arm_control: restore snapshot; global updates 101-200 at constant English LR 5e-5
per_seed_design.arm_treatment: restore the SAME snapshot; global updates 101-200 with English LR lr=5e-5*(90-j)/89 for post-100 English ordinal j=1..90 (first 5e-5, last 0); binding LR stays 5e-5
per_seed_design.fork_integrity: matched-step-101 gate: update 101 has identical LR (5e-5) in both arms; after the treatment arm's update-101 step, require full model+optimizer+RNG state equality with the control arm's update-101 state; mismatch = HARD STOP (restore bug or rare numeric event; not an outcome decision)

preserved_semantics.objective_english: causal answer+EOS CE (5 positions) + 1.0 x forward KL D_KL(student||Pilot1) over 160 frozen ordinary positions per English update; student KL in eval mode with grads; factual CE in train mode; T=1; full 1024-class support; float64 KL accumulation
preserved_semantics.objective_binding: pinned T13 answer causal CE + LAM 1.0536573711078283 hard-min localization objective
preserved_semantics.scope: English trains token/position embeddings, blocks 4-7, final norm, untied language head; blocks 0-3 and T13 localizer/retrieval frozen. Binding restores full scope.
preserved_semantics.optimizer: fresh AdamW 5e-5 betas(.9,.999) eps1e-8 wd.05 amsgrad=False foreach=False fused=False; gradient clip 2.0; one persistent state per arm from the shared snapshot; no LR scheduler object (per-update group LR assignment only)
preserved_semantics.schedule: global 200 updates = 20x(9 English + 1 binding); prefix 1-100; arm window 101-200
preserved_semantics.data: 16 SF1 TRAIN records x2 per English update (frozen SF1 SCHEDULE); binding rehearsal/dev pools unchanged

evaluation_and_gates.update0: baseline reproduction M9: acquisition 9/16 correct, 0/16 exact; aligned DEV CE 3.3907 within 1e-4 rel; D3 four-name mass 0.000907 within 1e-4 abs; binding both pools PASS; KL==0 within 1e-9
evaluation_and_gates.update100_prefix: full checks: language <= own update0 CE + 0.25; D3 <= 0.01; binding each pool answer>=76 AND BD>=76 AND collapse==0; acquisition guard (correct<10 AND exact<10) -> stop
evaluation_and_gates.arm_trajectory: acquisition panel at 125/150/175/200 (margins recorded; descriptive only)
evaluation_and_gates.arm_update200: full checks: language, D3, binding, acquisition endpoint (correct==16 AND exact==16 AND reversals==8 AND families==4)
evaluation_and_gates.arm_endpoint_pass: acquisition endpoint AND language AND D3 AND binding all pass at 200
evaluation_and_gates.rng_invariance: every evaluation must leave Python/CPU/GPU RNG state unchanged; violation = HARD STOP

primary_endpoint_per_replicate: binary endpoint-gate pass at update 200 for control vs treatment (acquisition AND retention gates), reported per arm per seed
secondary_endpoints: per-item margins at 100/125/150/175/200 for all 16 TRAIN items; four AO cell midpoints; Owen/Alex subgroup margins; margin of residual item TRAIN:g0:carried:wooden boat:a0; language CE, D3 mass, binding summaries at 200

decision_rule.SUPPORT: treatment passes the full endpoint gate in >=2 of 3 replicates while its matched control does not, and treatment never fails where control passes
decision_rule.WEAK_NO_SUPPORT: both arms pass in all replicates where control passes, or both fail in all replicates
decision_rule.HARM: treatment fails in >=1 replicate where control passes
decision_rule.statistics: exact counts and margins only; no p-values; no population generalization claims

transfer_lock: HELDOUT16/ALTERNATE48/COPY8/COMPETING64 open per arm ONLY if that arm passes ALL endpoint gates at 200; otherwise remain locked. FINAL and sacred never accessed.
execution_order: freeze -> preflight (fork/restore/arm-equality integrity, seed 87999, prefix truncated at update 12) -> seed 87011 -> seed 87012 -> seed 87013 -> finalize (decision rule) -> report. No retries chosen by outcome; no extra seeds; no schedule change; no follow-up experiment.
